events.text: A local official stops your caravan and 'inspects' the cargo very slowly. He is waiting for a bribe.

choices.text: Pay the bribe from the agency purse

effects.log: The caravan moves. The agency master grumbles and approves.

ok.log: He gives up by sunset. The client is impressed.

fail.log: Two days lost. The client is not impressed.

variants: A local official halts your caravan and examines the cargo, crate by crate, very slowly. He is waiting to be paid.

events.text: A new guard freezes when bandits appear and runs. He comes back that night, ashamed.

effects.log: On the next job he holds the line longest. He never runs again.
He is dismissed. The agency is safer. You feel older.

events.text: A client pays triple to escort a sealed box and refuses to say what is in it.

effects.log: Three ambushes on the road. Whatever it was, someone wanted it badly. (60 taels)
He tells you. It is a baby, the heir of a destroyed family. You take it for free.

events.text: The agency ledger does not add up. Someone has been skimming for years, and all the signs point to the master's nephew.

effects.log: The master is grieved, then grateful. The nephew is sent away.
He weeps and repays everything. The master never learns.

events.text: Your agency's founding day. Every guard, past and present, comes back for the feast.

choices.text: Toast the ones who died on the road

effects.log: Every name, read aloud. Every cup emptied.
The hall cheers. The guard cries into his wine.

events.text: The Nine Roads League meets. Two member agencies want to fight each other over a route.

ok.log: A fair split. The League holds.

effects.log: Nobody argues. Nobody is happy.

events.text: The man you have tracked for a month turns out to be the wrong man, a farmer with the same scar.

choices.text: Apologise and pay him for his trouble

effects.log: He is so surprised he gives you dinner.
The magistrate lets him go. You are not paid. The farmer spits at you.

variants: A month on his trail, and the man you finally corner is a farmer who happens to have the same scar.

events.text: One of the posters on the bounty board has the face of a swordsman you once crossed blades with, and a reward worth the trip.

effects.log: A long hunt, an ugly fight, a heavy purse. (80 taels)
The swordsman disappears into the mountains. Some things are worth more than silver.

variants: On the bounty board is a face you know: a swordsman you once crossed blades with, and a reward worth the journey.

events.text: A boy wants to be your apprentice. He has read every bounty tale and believes all of them.

effects.log: He is terrible, then competent, then good. He saves your life once.
'This is not a story,' you say. He goes home. He never forgets it.

events.text: The last name on your list has been running for ten years. You finally find him: old, blind and teaching children.

effects.log: You tear up the poster. Some hunts end differently.
He comes quietly. The children watch you take him.

events.text: One student has no talent at all, and never misses a lesson.

effects.log: Five years later he is the best in the school. Talent is overrated.
He becomes a very good carpenter. He still waves at you.

events.text: The rival school across town burns down. Its students stand in the street with nowhere to train.

effects.log: Your school doubles. So does the goodwill.
Business is business. Half of them join.

events.text: You are old. The school needs a successor: your most talented student, or your most loyal one.

effects.log: The school grows famous. Some old students leave.
The school stays a family. It never becomes great, and never breaks.

events.text: A village you saved last year holds a feast in your honour. They have spent their whole savings on it.

effects.log: The best feast of your life, and the most expensive for them.
You leave more than they spent. They find it after you are gone.

events.text: A travelling singer has written a song about you. It is wildly inaccurate and very catchy.

effects.log: He laughs and pays you in dumplings.
The new version is less exciting. Nobody sings it.

events.text: Young swordsmen across the empire are copying your clothes, your nickname and your worst habits.

choices.text: Give one of them a real lesson

effects.log: He goes home humbled and much better.
By next year they are copying someone else.

events.text: Outer disciples take turns in the sect kitchen. Today it is your turn, and the elder is very particular about tofu.

ok.log: The elder eats three bowls without a word. High praise.

fail.log: The tofu falls apart. So does the elder's mood.

choices.text: Sneak an extra portion to the juniors

effects.log: The juniors will follow you anywhere now.

events.text: Carrying water up the mountain before dawn, you find a shortcut down a cliff path. It halves the climb and doubles the risk.

ok.log: Every morning, half the time. Your legs become iron.

fail.log: You slip, spill everything and climb back the long way.

effects.log: Slower, and your endurance grows with every step.

events.text: As an inner disciple, you are trusted with the library key for one night.

choices.text: Read what you are allowed to

effects.log: Honest reading. Your technique sharpens.
Fascinating, and dangerous if anyone finds out.

events.text: The sect sends you to answer a rival sect's challenge. The elders watch from the stands.

ok.log: You win cleanly. The eldest elder nods once.

fail.log: You lose narrowly. The elders say nothing, which is worse.

choices.text: Propose a demonstration instead of a duel

effects.log: Both sects perform. Nobody loses face.

events.text: Your class has filled your meditation cushion with frogs.

effects.log: You sit perfectly still among forty frogs. The class never pranks you again.
Laps around the mountain. They love you less, and respect you more.

events.text: The council argues over the sect's budget: a new library wing or a new training hall.

effects.log: Scholars remember you. Fighters grumble.
Disciples cheer. Librarians sigh.

events.text: The sect leader is ill and the council looks to you to run things for a season.

effects.log: Nothing breaks. The leader recovers to a sect in good order.
Some work, some do not. Everyone has an opinion.

events.text: A young genius from a poor family asks to join, but the elders prefer children of great families.

effects.log: Years later, the sect's greatest master.
The genius joins a rival sect. You will meet again.

events.text: Your first raid with the stronghold. The target is a merchant caravan. The guards are three old men.

effects.log: You wave them off before the fighting starts. Nobody notices. Or they do and say nothing.
An easy haul. You do not sleep well.

events.text: The chief is drunk every night now, and the men are starting to look at you.

effects.log: The chief sobers up, eventually. He remembers who stayed.

choices.text: Let the men know you are ready

effects.log: Whispers begin. Dangerous ones.

events.text: An Orthodox sect besieges your stronghold. They want the leader of the raid on their merchant.

ok.log: They break against your walls and go home.

fail.log: They breach the outer wall before withdrawing.

effects.log: The siege ends. Your men look at you differently.

events.text: Seventy-two strongholds send tribute to your mountain. One sends a letter instead: a challenge.

ok.log: One duel, one lesson. Seventy-two tributes next year.

fail.log: You win, barely. The challenger is carried home.

effects.log: The lieutenant wins. The challenger becomes his friend. Politics.

events.text: Your target has a daughter who sits beside him every evening. There is never a moment alone.

effects.log: It never comes. The Pavilion recalls you. The man lives.
It works. You cannot eat for a week.

events.text: Another Night Blade has been sent after the same target. The Pavilion is testing you both.

ok.log: You finish first. The other blade bows to you in the dark.

fail.log: They finish first and laugh at you from a rooftop.

effects.log: Two blades, one job, half the risk. The Pavilion notes it.

events.text: An old assassin asks to leave the Pavilion. No one has ever left alive.

effects.log: The first. The Pavilion whispers. She sends you a letter every year.
She does not leave. The Pavilion is very quiet for a month.

events.text: Your sect's first winter. The halls are cold, the rice is short and three disciples are thinking of leaving.

effects.log: You are thin by spring. Nobody leaves.

choices.text: Take a mercenary job to pay for rice

effects.log: A season away. The sect survives, but misses you.

events.text: Your first disciple brings you tea every morning, and every morning it is terrible.

effects.log: Ten years of terrible tea. You would not trade a cup.
The tea improves. The disciple learns that patience is also a martial art.

events.text: Everyone compares you to the founder. The old disciples say 'the founder would have done it differently'.

effects.log: Some old disciples leave. Many young ones come.
You find the founder doubted everything too. It helps.

events.text: A prisoner sings every night on your watch, a mountain song from your home region.

effects.log: Nobody hears. For a moment you are both home.
He stops. The silence is worse.

events.text: Your black mask chafes on a long raid. Under it you are just a person who is very tired.

effects.log: A good warrior is a mask. You are a good warrior.

choices.text: Take it off for a moment by the river

effects.log: A child sees your face. She is not afraid. You are.

events.text: A new recruit in your squad joined the Cult to escape a forced marriage, not to fight.

choices.text: Keep her away from the front

effects.log: She becomes the squad's scribe. Everyone lives longer.
She becomes the best of your squad and never forgives you.

events.text: Another Hall Master is spreading rumours that your hall is disloyal.

ok.log: The council believes you. The other Hall Master is reassigned.

fail.log: The rumours stick for a season.

effects.log: You find one. He stops talking about you.

events.text: The Heavenly Demon is in a dark mood. The whole mountain whispers. You stand behind the throne.

effects.log: You survive the day. Some do not.
A long, terrible silence. Then a nod. You have been noticed.

events.text: You catch an Orthodox spy in the archives. She is very young and very scared.

effects.log: The council is pleased.

choices.text: Let her escape with false plans

effects.log: She escapes, carrying lies. The Orthodox waste a season on them.

events.text: The Heavenly Demon's own child openly despises you. The succession will not be simple.

effects.log: Slowly, with respect. It may work.
Dangerous, and effective.

events.text: On the throne of the Hundred Thousand Mountains, you realise no one has spoken to you as a person in years.

choices.text: Walk the mountain alone at night

effects.log: A guard sees you and pretends not to. You both need that.

choices.text: Invite an old friend to dinner

effects.log: They come, terrified, then laughing. For one night you are not the Heavenly Demon.

events.text: Two villages fight over a bridge. Both claim the Alliance is on their side.

ok.log: A shared toll, a shared festival. Peace.

fail.log: Both villages complain to your captain about you.

effects.log: Problem solved, badly. Everyone now has to wade.

events.text: One of your patrolmen has been taking bribes from smugglers.

effects.log: The rest of the patrol straightens up overnight.
He repays the bribes and becomes your most honest man.

events.text: Your intelligence reports keep reaching the Cult before they reach the Alliance Leader.

ok.log: A trusted clerk. You feed him false reports for a year first.

fail.log: You cannot find it. The Leader is displeased.

effects.log: Weeks of chaos, then silence. The leak dries up.

events.text: Your shift ends at dawn. It has been a long night of nothing, which is exactly the job.

effects.log: Nothing happens. Nothing happens because you are there.

choices.text: Share tea with the next guard

effects.log: You talk about home until the sun comes up.

events.text: A great sect offers you a fortune to support their candidate for the next Alliance Leader.

effects.log: They will remember. So will the sects who heard you refuse.
Very rich, very compromised. (200 taels)

events.text: The Cult proposes a ten-year truce. Half the Alliance wants it, half wants war.

effects.log: Ten years of peace. Children grow up who never saw a war.
The Alliance arms. The history books will decide who was right.
